s17_text: RUN_PLAN.md:1706-1710: 'Any code change on a statistic path once a claim result exists (a crash fix included): 1. P0-P26 are rerun; 2. asdg-skeptic re-reviews before any further claim runs; 3. every completed row whose computation passes through the changed code is rerun; 4. both versions are reported, with the change, its commit and its reason.'
definition: statistic path = code that computes, selects or transforms a value entering a statistic, a p, a verdict or their inputs (map, set, matrix, parcels, seeds), OR that carries those values from the computation to the row record (dispatch, checkpoint save / load, payload-to-row assignment). Not a statistic path: a label or reading text, a recorded rule text, pacing (when to stop dispatching), hashing / provenance, output locations, plant or test scaffolding, a material-stage branch no completed row read.
